candidates.title: Cups of Code: Connecting the Community
candidates.description:
C.O.D.E - Community of Developers & Engineers
A fun and light code session where tech friends get together in a large and relaxed café space, and code! Bring your laptop (or another coding device of choice) for a great opportunity to ask questions, share ongoing projects, help each other out, and meet other awesome coders. We're all about the code, and we hope to make a space for people who like to build.

**Notes to keep in mind:**

\*Guest wireless internet access is good and free

Come out and work, help, or just hang out!
